lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Esporte (win, beat, lose, draw, referee, coach, match, pitch), play / do / go com esportes.

head: Usa-se
Para
Exemplos
rows: esportes com bola ou jogo contra alguém
play football (jogar futebol), play tennis (jogar tênis)
go swimming (ir nadar), go running (ir correr), go cycling (ir pedalar)
do yoga (fazer yoga), do karate (fazer caratê), do gymnastics (fazer ginástica)

aula.text: **Outras palavras:** coach (técnico), referee (árbitro), fan (torcedor), opponent (adversário), pitch (campo), court (quadra), match (partida), tournament (torneio).

items: "I make sport three times a week." O certo é **I do sport** (ou: I play football).
"We won the other team." O certo é **We beat the other team.** (win é ganhar um jogo, beat é vencer alguém)

exercises.prompt: I make sport three times a week.
acc: I do sport three times a week

exercises.prompt: The match ended 1-1. It was a ___.

chat.goal: 6 palavras de esporte e 2 usos corretos de play, do ou go.

lessons.title: Tempos do passado
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Past simple, past continuous, past perfect; when / while.

head: Tempo
Uso
Exemplo
rows: I opened the door and saw a dog.
It was raining and I was waiting for the bus.
ação anterior a outro momento do passado
When I arrived, the match had already started.

aula.text: **when e while:** *I was running when I fell.* ou *While I was running, I fell.* A ação longa fica no continuous e a curta, que interrompe, fica no past simple.

items: "When I arrived, the film already started." O certo é **had already started.**
"When I was walking home, I have seen an accident." O certo é **When I was walking home, I saw an accident.**
"While I was waited..." O certo é **While I was waiting...**

exercises.prompt: I ___ (walk) home when it ___ (start) to rain.
When we got to the stadium, the game ___ (already / start).
She ___ (win) the race because she ___ (train) every day for a year.
When I arrived, the film already started.
acc: When I arrived, the film had already started

exercises.prompt: When I was walking home, I have seen an accident.
acc: When I was walking home, I saw an accident

exercises.prompt: While I was waited, I read a magazine.
acc: While I was waiting, I read a magazine

lessons.title: Inglês prático, contar uma história
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Contar uma história ou anedota.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Guess what happened to me... / You won't believe this... / Let me tell you what happened...
First, ... / Then ... / After that ... / Later ... / Suddenly, ... / In the end, ...
And then what? / What happened next? / No way! / Seriously? / How awful!
So that's why... / And that's how... / It was a day I'll never forget.

items: "At the end, I found my keys." O certo é **In the end.**
"After, I went home." O certo é **After that** ou **Afterwards.**

exercises.prompt: ___ that, we went to the restaurant.
We were walking home when, ___, a dog ran out.
At the end, we won the match.
acc: In the end, we won the match

exercises.prompt: (a) Suddenly the lights went out. (b) First, I arrived at the stadium. (c) In the end, the match was cancelled. (d) Then I found my seat. Ordem: ___
